import { requireText } from '../shared/RequiredText';

export class User {
  private constructor(
    readonly id: string,
    readonly name: string,
  ) {}

  static create(id: string, name: string): User {
    return new User(requireText(id, 'User id'), requireText(name, 'User name'));
  }
}
